title: Truncation error from a size bound
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on $\{\pm1\}^n$ whose terms are conjunctions of literals on distinct coordinates. If its number of terms is at most $s$, then, for every $\varepsilon>0$, the fraction of inputs on which $\varphi$ differs from the formula retaining only terms of width at most $\lceil\log_2(s/\varepsilon)\rceil$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: A DNF formula on the Boolean cube of dimension n
Each term has distinct literal coordinates
The formula has at most s terms
